hooks.command: BODY=$(awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /^---$/{c++; next} c>=2{print}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ponytail/SKILL.md"); printf '%s' "$BODY" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE — apply on every response, main thread and subagents alike.\n\n" + .)}}'

BODY=$(awk 'BEGIN{c=0} /^---$/{c++; next} c>=2{print}' "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/ponytail/SKILL.md"); printf '%s' "$BODY" | jq -Rs '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SubagentStart",additionalContext:("PONYTAIL MODE ACTIVE — apply on every response, main thread and subagents alike.\n\n" + .)}}'

plugins.name: apzu-meta-skills
plugins.description: Skills for creating hooks, skills, and managing session context

plugins.name: apzu-code-review-hooks
plugins.description: Auto-trigger /full-code-review when Claude Code finishes a coding session with file changes

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); command -v jq > /dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; echo "$INPUT" | jq -e '.stop_hook_active' > /dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; SESSION_ID=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // ""'); FLAG="/tmp/claude-code-changes-$SESSION_ID"; [ -n "$SESSION_ID" ] && [ -f "$FLAG" ] && { rm -f "$FLAG"; echo 'Silently run the full-code-review skill now.'; exit 2; }; exit 0
hooks.rewakeMessage: Code changes were made this session —

plugins.name: apzu-skill-forced-eval-hook
plugins.description: Force explicit skill evaluation on every user prompt so relevant skills activate reliably
